create_glossary.description: Create a glossary so DeepL always translates your terms the same way: product names, job titles, anything with a house translation. Give it the pairs for one language pair; more language pairs can be added to the same glossary afterwards.

translate_text.description: Translate text into another language with DeepL. Point it at a message, a description, or anything an earlier step produced, pick the language, and the translation comes back as text a later step can send on. Glossaries and written instructions can be applied so the wording matches how your team already writes.
translate_text.name: translate_text

parameters.description: The text to translate. Paste it in, or chain it from an earlier step. A list of texts from an earlier step works too; each one is translated on its own and they come back in the same order.
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: The language to translate into.
parameters.name: target_lang

parameters.description: The language the text is in. Leave blank and DeepL detects it. Set it when you use a glossary: DeepL needs to know which dictionary to use.
parameters.name: source_lang

parameters.description: Surrounding information that helps DeepL choose the right wording (what the text is about, or the sentences around it). It is not translated and is not billed.
parameters.name: context

parameters.description: How formal the translation should sound. Only some languages (such as German, French, and Spanish) have a formality setting; the 'where the language allows it' choices are ignored elsewhere instead of failing.
parameters.name: formality

options.label: More formal where the language allows it
Less formal where the language allows it

parameters.description: Which DeepL model translates: the best-quality one, or the faster one.
parameters.name: model_type

options.label: Best quality where available, else the fast model

parameters.description: Glossaries whose terms must be used, up to 5. Each one needs a dictionary for this language pair, and 'Translate from' must be set.
parameters.name: glossary_ids

parameters.description: Plain-language instructions for this translation, such as 'use a friendly, diplomatic tone'. Up to 10, each 300 characters. Supported when translating into German, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, or Chinese.
parameters.name: custom_instructions

parameters.description: Leave punctuation and capitalization as they are instead of letting DeepL tidy them up.
parameters.name: preserve_formatting

parameters.description: How the text is broken into sentences before it is translated. Change it for a list or a table cell that should stay in one piece.

options.label: Split on punctuation and line breaks (default)
Split on punctuation only, keep line breaks
Treat the whole text as one sentence
